messages:
riley: FYI PR #5380 seems to bump long-seq p95 in canary. Observed ~120ms -> ~150ms on 8k tokens. Noticed higher GPU mem at tail.

alex: link to PR? can you paste bench numbers + how you ran it?

riley: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5380
Ran local canary on ci-canary-42, model: redwood-13b-8k, batch=1, seq=8192, tokens per req 8192
Bench summary:
```
Baseline (main): p50 78ms p95 120ms throughput 220 tok/s GPU mem 9.2GB
PR5380:       p50 85ms p95 152ms throughput 205 tok/s GPU mem 11.6GB
```
Logs: attaching snippet where kv-evict kicks in and headroom drops, see repeated eviction loop at ~t+2s.

sam: hmm looks like KV cache eviction changed timing. Did you try burst/batch adjustments?

riley: re-ran with microbatching=2 and kv_evict_threshold=0.75
```
PR5380 (microbatch=2): p50 80ms p95 137ms throughput 210 tok/s GPU mem 10.4GB
```
Improvement but still ~14ms p95 reg.

morgan: I left inline review comments about the new cache loop. @alex can you take one more pass on the lock ordering? This needs 1 more approval to merge.

alex: I'll take a look this afternoon. quick ask: can we get a minimal repro script? saves time.

riley: added repro script to PR, gist: https://gist.github.com/riley/abc123
usage:
```
./bench_longseq.sh --model redwood-13b --seq 8192 --runs 100
```

canary-bot: Canary deploy 5380 started on ci-canary-42 (2026-06-01 15:12 UTC). Running 100 requests.

canary-bot: Canary results: 95/100 OK. p95 delta +13ms. No OOMs. Throughput -6%.

alex: ok I'm +1 on fixes and comments addressed. @morgan can you approve w/ admin merge if canary finishes clean?

morgan: will wait for final 10 canary runs to finish then merge. tagging release-2026.06.01 if green :thumbsup:

riley: thanks all — will follow up if regressions persist in prod.
